Most people only search for 2 or 3 titles they already know.

slides.headline: 2) BUILD A SEARCH STRING THAT CUTS OUT BAD LISTINGS

This prompt builds a Boolean string that filters them out before you ever see them.

caption:
Swipe for 5 AI prompts that find high-quality remote jobs in under 2 minutes. 💼 No job board, no hours of scrolling.

1) find remote job titles that match your exact skills, including ones most people never think to search for,
2) build a Boolean search string that cuts out recruiters and contract-only listings,
3) score your resume against any job description in 30 seconds before you apply,
4) find companies in your field known for remote hiring,
5) write a cold DM to a hiring manager that bypasses the job board entirely.

Most people search for remote jobs the same way they did in 2015. Keyword search, hours of scrolling, dozens of applications, almost no replies. AI flips the whole process: start from your skills, work backward to the right titles, the right companies, the right first message. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.
